newsitem.title: USA: U.S. stocks move lower as rally attempt fails.
newsitem.headline: U.S. stocks move lower as rally attempt fails.

text.p: Wall Street turned lower early Thursday afternoon as a morning rally proved unsustainable.
The market remains nervous, prompting some to sell into any signs of strength, analysts said.
The Dow was off 26.68 points, or 0.34 percent, at 7901.84.
Nasdaq also turned lower, down 1.51 points or 0.10 percent at 1581.89.
The long bond was up 21/32 to yield 6.57 percent.
